_comment: THE SHAPE build-review.js EXPECTS. Copy to review-queue.json and fill it from the batch.
Two arrays and nothing else: done, and needs. Not what I tried, not what I considered.
DONE items: label, title, optional href to look at it, optional one-line note.
NEEDS items: 'decision' is the headline and must be answerable, not a description.
kind: 'page'  -> href, shown live in an iframe at phone AND desktop width
kind: 'image' -> src, shown inline (artwork, a screenshot in the scratchpad)
kind: 'text'  -> optional code, for a snippet
options: turns a decision into one word instead of a paragraph
An EMPTY needs array is the best possible result and renders as one green line.
budget: Roughly half the session used. Four more analysed and ready.
